create_transform_img_to_tensor: create an ImgToTensor transform that converts PIL images or numpy arrays to float32 torch tensors in CHW format
run_transform_pil_to_tensor: run the ImgToTensor transform on a PIL image to produce a normalized torch tensor
run_transform_numpy_to_tensor: run the ImgToTensor transform on a numpy array to produce a normalized torch tensor
test_is_numpy_helper: test the _is_numpy helper function that checks if an input is a numpy ndarray
test_is_pil_image_helper: test the _is_pil_image helper function that checks if an input is a PIL or accimage image
